# tlottie (vendored)

- Manba: https://github.com/dkaraush/tlottie
- Commit: `685f17e348c613d4d62896f49fc01f6ec4e8f028` — aynan shu commit
  Telegram Android va Cherrygram'da (`TMessagesProj/jni/tlottie`

- Litsenziya: MIT (`Cargo.toml` dagi `license = "MIT"`).
